method: DATA-LEVEL bootstrap: resample TREES with replacement WITHIN each source block (preserves block structure), recompute within-source CLIP(PCA-11d)-minus-geo(11d) NMI residual at FIXED KMeans seed=0, so the measured spread is DATA sampling not init jitter. BioDiv: only 3 region blocks -> a block-level bootstrap is uninformative, so we resample TREES with replacement within each of the 3 regions (tree-level).
